topic: Explanation on the records and labels used in calibration of aircraft test equipment.
syllabus_extract: Explanation on the records and labels used in calibration of aircraft test equipment.
specific_objectives: 24.14.1.1 Trainee will be able to evaluate the level and periodicity on calibration of aircraft test equipment.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of sample calibration certificates and identification of label status codes.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of calibrating aircraft test equipment?
Why is it critical to check the calibration status before flight operations?
Can you identify the difference between a serviceable and unserviceable calibration label?

development.content:
Types of Calibration Labels
Color Coding Standards
Label Placement Requirements
Interpretation of Status Codes
Expiry Date Verification

Calibration Record Structure
Data Entry Requirements
Traceability Documentation
Discrepancy Reporting
Record Retention Periods

Evaluating Calibration Periodicity
Determining Level of Calibration
Assessing Equipment Suitability
Identifying Overdue Items
Planning Maintenance Schedules

summary_questions: How do you determine if a test equipment item is overdue for calibration?
What specific information must be recorded in a calibration certificate?
Explain the significance of the color code on a calibration label.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the calibration status of three specific test equipment items found in the squadron, referencing their labels and records, to be discussed in LP 19 regarding handling and testing precautions.
